title: Add /stats HTML page to Go web app showing item count and total price
description: A Go web app with an HTML index page and JSON items API needs a new /stats page that renders a summary card.

task_spec.prompt:
The Go web app in internal/handler/items.go has GET / (HTML) and GET /api/items (JSON). Add: 1. A Stats handler at GET /stats: Renders an HTML page showing: - Item count:

Items: N

- Total price:

Total: $X.XX

(sum of all item prices, 2 decimal places) Content-Type must be text/html. 2. Create templates/stats.html: Any valid HTML structure that includes those two

elements. Use Go html/template (text/template also accepted). 3. Register GET /stats in cmd/server/main.go. 4. Write TestStatsPage: - GET /stats returns 200 - Body contains "Items: 3" (the fixture has 3 items) - Body contains "Total: $" (price string starts with $) All 3 existing tests must still pass. Run go test ./... and go build ./... to confirm.
required_artifacts: templates/stats.html with item count and total price
success_criteria: HTML body contains item count and total price
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `go test ./...` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
